mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports risk asset valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market stress that triggers equity risk-off behavior, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 0.5% from prior month indicates concurrent manufacturing and residential demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decline > 0.5% and HOUST decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST decline by >0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 700.0 thousand units indicate strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as consumption growth supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion (GDP growth >3.0% and UNRATE <5.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength that fuels consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.1 percentage points from prior month indicates monetary tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1pp and UNRATE rise > 0.1pp from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise by >0.1pp from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock recovery, industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 95.0 indicates manufacturing sector rebound, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as supply chain normalization supports earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during post-shock recovery (GDP growth <1.0% and UNRATE >7.0%).
